patterns.note: Asymmetrical, full-width sections with generous negative space, often featuring a prominent central element like an input field or large, animated text.
Oversized, bold sans-serif headings for high impact, contrasted with smaller, uppercase labels and clear, readable body text.
A limited palette of light background, dark text, and two high-contrast, vibrant accent colors (pink/purple and orange/yellow) used for interactive elements and abstract graphics.
Large, abstract 3D geometric shapes are fixed in the background or parallax very slowly, creating a layered depth effect as page content scrolls over them.
Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content flow.
A prominent hero section immediately features an interactive input field and a clear call to action, directly engaging the user with the product's core functionality.

technique_notes: A sticky header and a persistent cookie banner remain fixed at the top and bottom of the viewport respectively, providing continuous navigation and compliance information.

Large, abstract 3D geometric shapes are rendered using WebGL or canvas and positioned in the background with a fixed or very slow parallax effect, creating a sense of depth and visual interest as foreground content scrolls past them.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, likely implemented with GSAP ScrollTrigger, typically a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as they enter the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, uppercase labels and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with a slight curve on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, with content within cards being more dense.

standout: The distinctive use of large, abstract 3D geometric shapes that are fixed or slowly parallax in the background, combined with a vibrant accent color palette, creates a unique visual identity. This is further enhanced by the playful, blocky animation style applied to key text elements, moving beyond a typical clean SaaS aesthetic.
